title: Contrapunctus XIII (rectus)

captions.text: ☞ Dux: the subject in the alto, then rising and falling triplets.
☞ The subject inverted in the bass.
☞ The answer in the soprano, right way up: all three voices are in.
☞ The subject in the bass, on F.
☞ The last entry: the subject inverted in the soprano.

listenFor: a mirror fugue in three voices; the subject and its inversion take turns
